local kinds = {"I", "O", "T", "S", "Z", "J", "L"}
local movements = {"L", "R", "LL", "RR", "SD", "DD", "CW", "CCW"}
local operation_names = {"L", "R", "LL", "RR", "SD", "DD", "CW", "CCW", "HD", "LOCK", "HOLD"}
local command_names = {
    "NEW",
    "PRINT",
    "NEXT",
    "PREVIEW",
    "STATUS",
    "ANALYZE",
    "ROW",
    "GARBAGE",
    "ATTACK",
    "TICK",
    "UNDO",
    "SAVE",
    "LOAD",
    "SPINS",
    "HINT",
    "AUTO"
}
local after_end = {"PRINT", "NEXT", "PREVIEW", "STATUS", "ANALYZE", "LOAD"}
local states = {"0", "R", "2", "L"}
local clear_names = {
    "SINGLE",
    "DOUBLE",
    "TRIPLE",
    "TETRIS",
    "TSPIN_MINI",
    "TSPIN_MINI_SINGLE",
    "TSPIN_MINI_DOUBLE",
    "TSPIN",
    "TSPIN_SINGLE",
    "TSPIN_DOUBLE",
    "TSPIN_TRIPLE"
}
local frames = {
    I = {"....", "####", "....", "...."},
    O = {"##", "##"},
    T = {".#.", "###", "..."},
    S = {".##", "##.", "..."},
    Z = {"##.", ".##", "..."},
    J = {"#..", "###", "..."},
    L = {"..#", "###", "..."}
}
local shapes = {}
for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
    local blocks = {}
    for j, line in ipairs(frames[kind]) do
        for i = 1, #line do
            if line:sub(i, i) == "#" then
                blocks[#blocks + 1] = {i - 1, j - 1}
            end
        end
    end
    shapes[kind] = {blocks}
    for s = 2, 4 do
        local next_blocks = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(blocks) do
            next_blocks[#next_blocks + 1] = {#frames[kind] - 1 - b[2], b[1]}
        end
        blocks = next_blocks
        shapes[kind][s] = blocks
    end
end
local ordinary_kicks = {
    ["01"] = {{0, 0}, {-1, 0}, {-1, 1}, {0, -2}, {-1, -2}},
    ["10"] = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {1, -1}, {0, 2}, {1, 2}},
    ["12"] = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {1, -1}, {0, 2}, {1, 2}},
    ["21"] = {{0, 0}, {-1, 0}, {-1, 1}, {0, -2}, {-1, -2}},
    ["23"] = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {1, 1}, {0, -2}, {1, -2}},
    ["32"] = {{0, 0}, {-1, 0}, {-1, -1}, {0, 2}, {-1, 2}},
    ["30"] = {{0, 0}, {-1, 0}, {-1, -1}, {0, 2}, {-1, 2}},
    ["03"] = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {1, 1}, {0, -2}, {1, -2}}
}
local i_kicks = {
    ["01"] = {{0, 0}, {-2, 0}, {1, 0}, {-2, -1}, {1, 2}},
    ["10"] = {{0, 0}, {2, 0}, {-1, 0}, {2, 1}, {-1, -2}},
    ["12"] = {{0, 0}, {-1, 0}, {2, 0}, {-1, 2}, {2, -1}},
    ["21"] = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {-2, 0}, {1, -2}, {-2, 1}},
    ["23"] = {{0, 0}, {2, 0}, {-1, 0}, {2, 1}, {-1, -2}},
    ["32"] = {{0, 0}, {-2, 0}, {1, 0}, {-2, -1}, {1, 2}},
    ["30"] = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {-2, 0}, {1, -2}, {-2, 1}},
    ["03"] = {{0, 0}, {-1, 0}, {2, 0}, {-1, 2}, {2, -1}}
}
local output = {}
local function emit(line)
    output[#output + 1] = line
end
local function member(items, value)
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == value then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function clone(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
        return value
    end
    local result = {}
    for k, v in pairs(value) do
        result[k] = clone(v)
    end
    return result
end
local function sum(a)
    local n = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(a) do
        n = n + v
    end
    return n
end
local function seed_step(x)
    return (48271 * x) % 2147483647
end
local function spawn(kind)
    return {0, kind == "O" and 5 or 4, 22}
end
local function pkey(p)
    return table.concat(p, ",")
end
local function cells(kind, p)
    local a = {}
    for _, b in ipairs(shapes[kind][p[1] + 1]) do
        a[#a + 1] = {p[2] + b[1], p[3] - b[2]}
    end
    return a
end
local function lowest(kind, p)
    local result = 23
    for _, b in ipairs(cells(kind, p)) do
        if b[2] < result then
            result = b[2]
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function bag(x)
    local pieces = clone(kinds)
    for i = 7, 2, -1 do
        x = seed_step(x)
        local j = x % i + 1
        pieces[i], pieces[j] = pieces[j], pieces[i]
    end
    return x, pieces
end
local function fits(board, kind, p)
    for _, b in ipairs(cells(kind, p)) do
        local c, r = b[1], b[2]
        if c < 1 or c > 10 or r < 1 or r > 22 or board[r] & (1 << (c - 1)) ~= 0 then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function move(board, kind, p, op)
    local s, x, y = p[1], p[2], p[3]
    if op == "CW" or op == "CCW" then
        local b = (s + (op == "CW" and 1 or 3)) % 4
        local offsets =
            kind == "O" and {{0, 0}} or
            (kind == "I" and i_kicks or ordinary_kicks)[tostring(s) .. tostring(b)]
        for i, k in ipairs(offsets) do
            local q = {b, x + k[1], y + k[2]}
            if fits(board, kind, q) then
                return q, i
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local dx = (op == "L" or op == "LL") and -1 or (op == "R" or op == "RR") and 1 or 0
    local dy = dx == 0 and -1 or 0
    local repeat_move = op == "LL" or op == "RR" or op == "DD"
    local position = p
    local changed = false
    repeat
        local q = {s, position[2] + dx, position[3] + dy}
        if not fits(board, kind, q) then
            break
        end
        position = q
        changed = true
    until not repeat_move
    if changed then
        return position, 0
    end
    return nil
end
local function landing(board, kind, p)
    return move(board, kind, p, "DD") or p
end
local function placed(board, kind, p)
    local result = clone(board)
    for _, b in ipairs(cells(kind, p)) do
        result[b[2]] = result[b[2]] | (1 << (b[1] - 1))
    end
    local remaining = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(result) do
        if row ~= 1023 then
            remaining[#remaining + 1] = row
        end
    end
    local lines = 22 - #remaining
    for i = 1, lines do
        remaining[#remaining + 1] = 0
    end
    return remaining, lines
end
local function evaluate(board, cleared)
    local heights = {}
    local holes, bumpiness = 0, 0
    for c = 1, 10 do
        local height = 0
        for r = 22, 1, -1 do
            if board[r] & (1 << (c - 1)) ~= 0 then
                height = r
                break
            end
        end
        heights[c] = height
        for r = 1, height do
            if board[r] & (1 << (c - 1)) == 0 then
                holes = holes + 1
            end
        end
    end
    for c = 1, 9 do
        bumpiness = bumpiness + math.abs(heights[c] - heights[c + 1])
    end
    return {
        heights = heights,
        holes = holes,
        bumpiness = bumpiness,
        value = 76 * cleared - 51 * sum(heights) - 36 * holes - 18 * bumpiness
    }
end
local function routes(board, kind, start, target)
    if not fits(board, kind, start) then
        return {}
    end
    local queue = {{position = start, keys = {}}}
    local seen = {[pkey(start)] = true}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #queue do
        local entry = queue[i]
        i = i + 1
        if target and pkey(landing(board, kind, entry.position)) == pkey(target) then
            return {entry}
        end
        for _, op in ipairs(movements) do
            local p = move(board, kind, entry.position, op)
            if p and not seen[pkey(p)] then
                seen[pkey(p)] = true
                local keys = clone(entry.keys)
                keys[#keys + 1] = op
                queue[#queue + 1] = {position = p, keys = keys}
            end
        end
    end
    if target then
        return {}
    end
    return queue
end
local function tspin(board, p, test)
    local s, x, y = p[1], p[2], p[3]
    local corners = {{x, y}, {x + 2, y}, {x + 2, y - 2}, {x, y - 2}}
    local blocked = {}
    local total = 0
    for i, b in ipairs(corners) do
        local c, r = b[1], b[2]
        blocked[i] = c < 1 or c > 10 or r < 1 or r > 22 or board[r] & (1 << (c - 1)) ~= 0
        if blocked[i] then
            total = total + 1
        end
    end
    if total < 3 then
        return ""
    end
    if blocked[s + 1] and blocked[(s + 1) % 4 + 1] or test == 5 then
        return "full"
    end
    return "mini"
end
local function clear_info(spin, lines)
    if spin == "full" then
        return ({"TSPIN", "TSPIN_SINGLE", "TSPIN_DOUBLE", "TSPIN_TRIPLE"})[lines + 1], ({
            400,
            800,
            1200,
            1600
        })[lines + 1], ({0, 2, 4, 6})[lines + 1]
    end
    if spin == "mini" then
        return ({"TSPIN_MINI", "TSPIN_MINI_SINGLE", "TSPIN_MINI_DOUBLE"})[lines + 1], ({
            100,
            200,
            400
        })[lines + 1], ({0, 0, 1})[lines + 1]
    end
    return ({"", "SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "TETRIS"})[lines + 1], ({0, 100, 300, 500, 800})[
        lines + 1
    ], ({0, 0, 1, 2, 4})[lines + 1]
end
local Game = {}
Game.__index = Game
function Game.new(number, seed, level)
    local stats = {
        drops = 0,
        holds = 0,
        operations = 0,
        faults = 0,
        perfect = 0,
        sent = 0,
        cancelled = 0,
        received = 0,
        combo = 0,
        chain = 0,
        kinds = {},
        clears = {}
    }
    for _, k in ipairs(kinds) do
        stats.kinds[k] = 0
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(clear_names) do
        stats.clears[name] = 0
    end
    local s = {
        board = {},
        random = seed,
        queue = {},
        hold = nil,
        used_hold = false,
        kind = "I",
        position = spawn("I"),
        last = "none",
        test = 0,
        keys = 0,
        drop = 0,
        fall = 0,
        ground = 0,
        resets = 0,
        lowest = 0,
        initial_level = level,
        level = level,
        score = 0,
        lines = 0,
        pieces = 0,
        streak = 0,
        chain = 0,
        pending = {},
        ended = false,
        stats = stats
    }
    for i = 1, 22 do
        s.board[i] = 0
    end
    local self = setmetatable({number = number, s = s, history = {}, start = {}, saves = {}}, Game)
    self:add_bag()
    self:spawn_piece(self:next_piece())
    self.start = clone(self.s)
    return self
end
function Game:add_bag()
    local pieces
    self.s.random, pieces = bag(self.s.random)
    for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
        self.s.queue[#self.s.queue + 1] = piece
    end
end
function Game:next_piece()
    local kind = table.remove(self.s.queue, 1)
    if #self.s.queue < 5 then
        self:add_bag()
    end
    return kind
end
function Game:spawn_piece(kind)
    local s = self.s
    s.kind = kind
    s.position = spawn(kind)
    s.last = "none"
    s.test = 0
    s.keys = 0
    s.drop = 0
    s.fall = 0
    s.ground = 0
    s.resets = 0
    s.lowest = lowest(kind, s.position)
    if not fits(s.board, kind, s.position) then
        self:over("block out")
    end
end
function Game:over(reason)
    emit("game over " .. reason)
    self:summary()
    self.s.ended = true
    error("game over", 0)
end
function Game:update(p, last, test)
    local s = self.s
    s.position = p
    s.last = last
    s.test = test or 0
    local row = lowest(s.kind, p)
    if row < s.lowest then
        s.lowest = row
        s.resets = 0
    end
end
function Game:grounded()
    return move(self.s.board, self.s.kind, self.s.position, "SD") == nil
end
function Game:drops(rows)
    local s = self.s
    s.score = s.score + rows
    s.drop = s.drop + rows
    s.stats.drops = s.stats.drops + rows
end
function Game:insert_garbage(rows, hole)
    local s = self.s
    for r = 23 - rows, 22 do
        if s.board[r] ~= 0 then
            self:over("top out")
        end
    end
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, rows do
        result[i] = 1023 ~ (1 << (hole - 1))
    end
    for i = 1, 22 - rows do
        result[rows + i] = s.board[i]
    end
    s.board = result
end
function Game:operation(op)
    local s = self.s
    if member(movements, op) then
        s.keys = s.keys + 1
        local p, test = move(s.board, s.kind, s.position, op)
        if not p then
            emit("fail " .. op)
            return
        end
        if op == "SD" or op == "DD" then
            self:drops(s.position[3] - p[3])
            self:update(p, "move")
            s.fall = 0
            s.ground = 0
        else
            self:update(p, (op == "CW" or op == "CCW") and "rotation" or "move", test)
            if s.ground > 0 and s.resets < 15 then
                s.ground = 0
                s.resets = s.resets + 1
            end
        end
    elseif op == "HD" then
        local p = landing(s.board, s.kind, s.position)
        local rows = s.position[3] - p[3]
        self:drops(2 * rows)
        if rows > 0 then
            self:update(p, "move")
        end
        self:lock()
    elseif op == "LOCK" then
        if self:grounded() then
            self:lock()
        else
            emit("fail LOCK")
        end
    else
        if s.used_hold then
            emit("fail HOLD")
            return
        end
        s.used_hold = true
        s.stats.holds = s.stats.holds + 1
        local prev = s.hold
        s.hold = s.kind
        self:spawn_piece(prev or self:next_piece())
    end
end
function Game:tick()
    local s = self.s
    if not self:grounded() then
        s.ground = 0
        s.fall = s.fall + 1
        local interval =
            s.level >= 13 and 1 or ({60, 48, 37, 28, 21, 16, 11, 8, 6, 4, 3, 2})[s.level]
        if s.fall >= interval then
            self:update({s.position[1], s.position[2], s.position[3] - 1}, "move")
            s.fall = 0
        end
    else
        s.ground = s.ground + 1
        if s.ground >= 30 then
            self:lock()
        end
    end
end
function Game:lock()
    local s = self.s
    local kind, p = s.kind, s.position
    local old_cells = cells(kind, p)
    local shortlist = routes(s.board, kind, spawn(kind), p)
    local shortest = shortlist[1]
    local spin = kind == "T" and s.last == "rotation" and tspin(s.board, p, s.test) or ""
    local n
    s.board, n = placed(s.board, kind, p)
    self.history[#self.history + 1] = clone(self.start)
    s.pieces = s.pieces + 1
    s.stats.kinds[kind] = s.stats.kinds[kind] + 1
    s.stats.operations = s.stats.operations + s.keys
    local name, points, sent = clear_info(spin, n)
    local level = s.level
    points = points * level
    local back = false
    if n > 0 then
        s.streak = s.streak + 1
        if n == 4 or spin ~= "" then
            s.chain = s.chain + 1
            back = s.chain >= 2
        else
            s.chain = 0
        end
    else
        s.streak = 0
    end
    if back then
        points = math.floor(points * 3 / 2)
        sent = sent + 1
    end
    local combo = s.streak - 1
    local combo_points = combo >= 1 and 50 * combo * level or 0
    if combo >= 0 then
        sent = sent + ({0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5})[math.min(combo, 10) + 1]
    end
    local perfect = n > 0
    if perfect then
        for _, row in ipairs(s.board) do
            if row ~= 0 then
                perfect = false
                break
            end
        end
    end
    local perfect_points =
        perfect and (n == 4 and back and 3200 or ({800, 1200, 1800, 2000})[n]) * level or 0
    if perfect then
        sent = sent + 10
        s.stats.perfect = s.stats.perfect + 1
    end
    local gained = points + combo_points + perfect_points
    s.score = s.score + gained
    s.lines = s.lines + n
    s.stats.sent = s.stats.sent + sent
    s.stats.combo = math.max(s.stats.combo, combo)
    s.stats.chain = math.max(s.stats.chain, s.chain)
    emit(
        string.format(
            "lock %d %s %s %d %d keys %d %s drop %d lines %d sent %d +%d total %d",
            s.pieces,
            kind,
            states[p[1] + 1],
            p[2],
            p[3],
            s.keys,
            shortest and tostring(#shortest.keys) or "-",
            s.drop,
            n,
            sent,
            gained,
            s.score
        )
    )
    if shortest and s.keys > #shortest.keys then
        s.stats.faults = s.stats.faults + 1
        emit("finesse " .. (#shortest.keys > 0 and table.concat(shortest.keys, " ") or "none"))
    end
    if name ~= "" then
        s.stats.clears[name] = s.stats.clears[name] + 1
        local line = "clear " .. name .. " " .. points
        if back then
            line = line .. " b2b"
        end
        if combo >= 1 then
            line = line .. " combo " .. combo .. " " .. combo_points
        end
        if perfect then
            line = line .. " perfect " .. perfect_points
        end
        emit(line)
    end
    local next_level = s.initial_level + math.floor(s.lines / 10)
    if next_level > level then
        s.level = next_level
        emit("level " .. s.level)
    end
    local lock_out = true
    for _, b in ipairs(old_cells) do
        if b[2] < 21 then
            lock_out = false
            break
        end
    end
    if lock_out then
        self:over("lock out")
    end
    local cancelled = math.min(sent, sum(s.pending))
    local remaining = cancelled
    while remaining > 0 do
        local n1 = math.min(remaining, s.pending[1])
        remaining = remaining - n1
        s.pending[1] = s.pending[1] - n1
        if s.pending[1] == 0 then
            table.remove(s.pending, 1)
        end
    end
    if cancelled > 0 then
        s.stats.cancelled = s.stats.cancelled + cancelled
        emit("cancel " .. cancelled .. " pending " .. sum(s.pending))
    end
    if n == 0 then
        local risen = 0
        while #s.pending > 0 and risen < 8 do
            local count = math.min(s.pending[1], 8 - risen)
            s.random = seed_step(s.random)
            local hole = s.random % 10 + 1
            self:insert_garbage(count, hole)
            s.stats.received = s.stats.received + count
            risen = risen + count
            s.pending[1] = s.pending[1] - count
            if s.pending[1] == 0 then
                table.remove(s.pending, 1)
            end
            emit("rise " .. count .. " hole " .. hole .. " pending " .. sum(s.pending))
        end
    end
    s.used_hold = false
    self:spawn_piece(self:next_piece())
    self.start = clone(s)
end
function Game:candidates(kind, start, prefix)
    local s = self.s
    local result = {}
    local seen = {}
    for _, turns in ipairs({{}, {"CW"}, {"CW", "CW"}, {"CCW"}}) do
        local p = start
        local valid = true
        for _, turn in ipairs(turns) do
            local q = move(s.board, kind, p, turn)
            if not q then
                valid = false
                break
            end
            p = q
        end
        if valid then
            local function add(q, shifts)
                local landed = landing(s.board, kind, q)
                local indexes = {}
                for _, b in ipairs(cells(kind, landed)) do
                    indexes[#indexes + 1] = (b[2] - 1) * 10 + b[1] - 1
                end
                table.sort(indexes)
                local key = table.concat(indexes, ",")
                if seen[key] then
                    return
                end
                seen[key] = true
                local board, n = placed(s.board, kind, landed)
                local keys = {}
                for _, part in ipairs({prefix, turns, shifts, {"HD"}}) do
                    for _, name in ipairs(part) do
                        keys[#keys + 1] = name
                    end
                end
                result[#result + 1] = {value = evaluate(board, n).value, kind = kind, keys = keys}
            end
            add(p, {})
            for _, direction in ipairs({"L", "R"}) do
                local q = p
                local shifts = {}
                while true do
                    local nextp = move(s.board, kind, q, direction)
                    if not nextp then
                        break
                    end
                    q = nextp
                    shifts[#shifts + 1] = direction
                    add(q, shifts)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end
function Game:ranked()
    local s = self.s
    local result = self:candidates(s.kind, s.position, {})
    local held = s.hold or s.queue[1]
    if not s.used_hold and fits(s.board, held, spawn(held)) then
        for _, c in ipairs(self:candidates(held, spawn(held), {"HOLD"})) do
            result[#result + 1] = c
        end
    end
    for i, c in ipairs(result) do
        c.order = i
    end
    table.sort(
        result,
        function(a, b)
            if a.value == b.value then
                return a.order < b.order
            else
                return a.value > b.value
            end
        end
    )
    return result
end
function Game:spins()
    local s = self.s
    if s.kind ~= "T" then
        emit("spins 0")
        return
    end
    local found = {}
    for _, route in ipairs(routes(s.board, s.kind, s.position)) do
        for _, turn in ipairs({"CW", "CCW"}) do
            local p, test = move(s.board, "T", route.position, turn)
            if p and not move(s.board, "T", p, "SD") then
                local spin = tspin(s.board, p, test)
                local key = pkey(p)
                if spin ~= "" and (not found[key] or spin == "full") then
                    found[key] = {position = p, spin = spin}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local candidates = {}
    for _, candidate in pairs(found) do
        candidates[#candidates + 1] = candidate
    end
    table.sort(
        candidates,
        function(a, b)
            local x, y = a.position, b.position
            if x[3] ~= y[3] then
                return x[3] < y[3]
            end
            if x[2] ~= y[2] then
                return x[2] < y[2]
            end
            return x[1] < y[1]
        end
    )
    for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
        local p = c.position
        local _, lines = placed(s.board, "T", p)
        local name = clear_info(c.spin, lines)
        emit("spin " .. states[p[1] + 1] .. " " .. p[2] .. " " .. p[3] .. " " .. name)
    end
    emit("spins " .. #candidates)
end
function Game:summary()
    local s = self.s
    local a = s.stats
    local c = a.clears
    local function ratio(x, y)
        local q = y == 0 and 0 or math.floor(100 * x / y)
        return string.format("%d.%02d", math.floor(q / 100), q % 100)
    end
    emit(
        string.format(
            "summary game %d score %d level %d lines %d pieces %d",
            self.number,
            s.score,
            s.level,
            s.lines,
            s.pieces
        )
    )
    emit(
        string.format(
            "clears single %d double %d triple %d tetris %d perfect %d",
            c.SINGLE,
            c.DOUBLE,
            c.TRIPLE,
            c.TETRIS,
            a.perfect
        )
    )
    emit(
        string.format(
            "tspins mini %d mini_single %d mini_double %d zero %d single %d double %d triple %d",
            c.TSPIN_MINI,
            c.TSPIN_MINI_SINGLE,
            c.TSPIN_MINI_DOUBLE,
            c.TSPIN,
            c.TSPIN_SINGLE,
            c.TSPIN_DOUBLE,
            c.TSPIN_TRIPLE
        )
    )
    local piece_counts = {}
    for _, k in ipairs(kinds) do
        piece_counts[#piece_counts + 1] = k .. " " .. a.kinds[k]
    end
    emit("pieces " .. table.concat(piece_counts, " "))
    emit(
        string.format(
            "best combo %d chain %d holds %d drops %d faults %d",
            a.combo,
            a.chain,
            a.holds,
            a.drops,
            a.faults
        )
    )
    emit(string.format("garbage sent %d cancelled %d received %d", a.sent, a.cancelled, a.received))
    emit(
        "rates app " ..
            ratio(a.sent, s.pieces) ..
                " apl " .. ratio(a.sent, s.lines) .. " kpp " .. ratio(a.operations, s.pieces)
    )
end
function Game:command(command, args)
    local s = self.s
    if command == "PRINT" then
        local current, ghost = {}, {}
        if not s.ended then
            for _, b in ipairs(cells(s.kind, s.position)) do
                current[b[2] * 10 + b[1]] = true
            end
            for _, b in ipairs(cells(s.kind, landing(s.board, s.kind, s.position))) do
                ghost[b[2] * 10 + b[1]] = true
            end
        end
        for r = 22, 1, -1 do
            local line = string.format("%2d ", r)
            for c = 1, 10 do
                if s.board[r] & (1 << (c - 1)) ~= 0 then
                    line = line .. "#"
                elseif current[r * 10 + c] then
                    line = line .. "@"
                elseif ghost[r * 10 + c] then
                    line = line .. "+"
                else
                    line = line .. "."
                end
            end
            emit(line)
        end
    elseif command == "NEXT" then
        local queue = {}
        for i = 1, 5 do
            queue[i] = s.queue[i]
        end
        emit("hold " .. (s.hold or "-") .. " next " .. table.concat(queue))
    elseif command == "PREVIEW" then
        local n = tonumber(args[1])
        local queue = clone(s.queue)
        local random = s.random
        while #queue < n do
            local pieces
            random, pieces = bag(random)
            for _, k in ipairs(pieces) do
                queue[#queue + 1] = k
            end
        end
        local list = {}
        for i = 1, n do
            list[i] = queue[i]
        end
        emit("preview " .. table.concat(list))
    elseif command == "STATUS" then
        emit(
            "score " ..
                s.score .. " level " .. s.level .. " lines " .. s.lines .. " pieces " .. s.pieces
        )
        local piece =
            s.ended and "-" or
            s.kind ..
                " " .. states[s.position[1] + 1] .. " " .. s.position[2] .. " " .. s.position[3]
        emit(
            "piece " ..
                piece ..
                    " streak " .. s.streak .. " chain " .. s.chain .. " pending " .. sum(s.pending)
        )
    elseif command == "ANALYZE" then
        local e = evaluate(s.board, 0)
        emit("heights " .. table.concat(e.heights, " "))
        emit("holes " .. e.holes .. " bumpiness " .. e.bumpiness .. " value " .. e.value)
    elseif command == "ROW" then
        local r = tonumber(args[1])
        local pattern = args[2]
        for _, b in ipairs(cells(s.kind, s.position)) do
            if b[2] == r and pattern:sub(b[1], b[1]) == "#" then
                emit("ERROR overlap")
                return
            end
        end
        local row = 0
        for i = 1, 10 do
            if pattern:sub(i, i) == "#" then
                row = row | (1 << (i - 1))
            end
        end
        s.board[r] = row
        emit("OK")
    elseif command == "GARBAGE" then
        local n, h = tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2])
        self:insert_garbage(n, h)
        for j = 0, n do
            local p = {s.position[1], s.position[2], s.position[3] + j}
            if fits(s.board, s.kind, p) then
                s.position = p
                emit("OK")
                return
            end
        end
        self:over("top out")
    elseif command == "ATTACK" then
        s.pending[#s.pending + 1] = tonumber(args[1])
        emit("pending " .. sum(s.pending))
    elseif command == "TICK" then
        for i = 1, tonumber(args[1]) do
            self:tick()
        end
    elseif command == "UNDO" then
        if #self.history == 0 then
            emit("ERROR nothing to undo")
        else
            self.s = table.remove(self.history)
            self.start = clone(self.s)
            emit("undo " .. self.s.pieces .. " " .. self.s.kind)
        end
    elseif command == "SAVE" then
        self.saves[args[1]] = {
            state = clone(s),
            history = clone(self.history),
            start = clone(self.start)
        }
        emit("OK")
    elseif command == "LOAD" then
        local saved = self.saves[args[1]]
        if not saved then
            emit("ERROR unknown save")
        else
            self.s = clone(saved.state)
            self.history = clone(saved.history)
            self.start = clone(saved.start)
            emit("load " .. self.s.pieces .. " " .. self.s.kind)
        end
    elseif command == "SPINS" then
        self:spins()
    elseif command == "HINT" then
        local ranked = self:ranked()
        for i = 1, math.min(tonumber(args[1]), #ranked) do
            local c = ranked[i]
            emit(
                "hint " ..
                    i .. " " .. c.kind .. " " .. table.concat(c.keys, " ") .. " value " .. c.value
            )
        end
    elseif command == "AUTO" then
        for i = 1, tonumber(args[1]) do
            local c = self:ranked()[1]
            emit("auto " .. c.kind .. " " .. table.concat(c.keys, " "))
            for _, op in ipairs(c.keys) do
                self:operation(op)
            end
        end
    end
end
local function valid_arguments(command, args)
    local function valid_number(text, min, max)
        if not text or not text:match("^%d+$") or (#text > 1 and text:sub(1, 1) == "0") then
            return false
        end
        local n = tonumber(text)
        return n >= min and n <= max
    end
    if command == "NEW" then
        return #args == 2 and valid_number(args[1], 1, 2147483646) and valid_number(args[2], 1, 15)
    end
    if command == "ROW" then
        return #args == 2 and valid_number(args[1], 1, 22) and #args[2] == 10 and
            args[2]:match("^[#%.]+$") ~= nil and
            args[2]:find("%.") ~= nil
    end
    if command == "GARBAGE" then
        return #args == 2 and valid_number(args[1], 1, 10) and valid_number(args[2], 1, 10)
    end
    if command == "SAVE" or command == "LOAD" then
        return #args == 1 and #args[1] >= 1 and #args[1] <= 8 and args[1]:match("^[a-z]+$") ~= nil
    end
    local limits = {PREVIEW = 14, ATTACK = 20, TICK = 1000, HINT = 10, AUTO = 50}
    if limits[command] then
        return #args == 1 and valid_number(args[1], 1, limits[command])
    end
    return #args == 0
end
local game = nil
local serial = 0
local n = tonumber(io.read("*l"))
for i = 1, n do
    local line = io.read("*l")
    local words = {}
    for word in line:gmatch("[^ ]+") do
        words[#words + 1] = word
    end
    local command = table.remove(words, 1)
    local args = words
    local ok, err =
        pcall(
        function()
            if member(command_names, command) then
                if not valid_arguments(command, args) then
                    emit("ERROR bad arguments")
                elseif command == "NEW" then
                    if game and not game.s.ended then
                        emit("game stopped")
                        game:summary()
                    end
                    serial = serial + 1
                    emit(
                        "game " ..
                            serial ..
                                " seed " .. tonumber(args[1]) .. " level " .. tonumber(args[2])
                    )
                    game = Game.new(serial, tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2]))
                elseif not game then
                    emit("ERROR no game")
                elseif game.s.ended and not member(after_end, command) then
                    emit("ERROR game over")
                else
                    game:command(command, args)
                end
            else
                local opwords = {command}
                for _, word in ipairs(args) do
                    opwords[#opwords + 1] = word
                end
                local bad = nil
                for _, word in ipairs(opwords) do
                    if not member(operation_names, word) then
                        bad = word
                        break
                    end
                end
                if bad then
                    emit("ERROR unknown " .. bad)
                elseif not game then
                    emit("ERROR no game")
                elseif game.s.ended then
                    emit("ERROR game over")
                else
                    for _, op in ipairs(opwords) do
                        game:operation(op)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    )
    if not ok and err ~= "game over" then
        error(err)
    end
end
if game and not game.s.ended then
    emit("game stopped")
    game:summary()
end
io.write(table.concat(output, "\n"), "\n")
